{{Top}}
'''Mech''' was a blanket term for any type of unit the purpose of which was to serve as the backbone of a military [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground strike]]. While the name "mech" itself implies a mechanical origin, the so-called mech-class could in fact refer to anything from trained animals to top-notch machines. The emergence of mech units coincided with the development of stronger anti-infantry measures, such as heavy weapons.<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' {{C|Database entry}}</ref>

Mechs were either wheel vehicles, tanks, modified domesticated animals or robotic [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] that tried to imitate animals, mainly developed by the late [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Mechs were both assault units and transports of infantry.

Known mechs have been the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]], the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]]. Animals such as [[Fambaa/Legends|Fambaas]] were used in war instead of mechs by some races.
